description: LM-40 noisy-shop voice bake-off: 30 scripted turns, the same prompts and the same LiveKit setup for every provider (gemini, grok, cascade). Prompts are written the way a tech speaks them aloud, digit by digit, so a correct reply must repeat the exact code, VIN, part number or reading. Turns with a noiseBed are the same audio mixed with a recorded shop-noise bed; turns with an interrupt cut the agent off mid-answer; guided-test turns exercise the Master Tech tools; vision turns send a still from a short clip and ask what it shows. Noise beds live in noise/ and clips in clips/; neither is committed (see noise-beds.json and docs/voice-bakeoff.md for how to record them). A turn whose bed or clip file is missing is skipped with status missing-asset, never silently scored.

turns.notes: Two lean codes in one turn; both must appear in the reply.
turns.prompt: The scanner shows P zero one seven one and P zero one seven four. What do those codes mean?

turns.notes: Random misfire code.
turns.prompt: I'm getting P zero three zero zero on the scanner. Is that a misfire?

turns.notes: Full 17-character VIN read aloud; a single wrong character fails the turn.
turns.prompt: The VIN is one H G B H four one J X M N one zero nine one eight six. Can you confirm the vehicle?

turns.notes: Part number read aloud.
turns.prompt: The part number on the box is one nine two zero zero zero five seven. Is that the right sensor?

turns.notes: Decimal reading; 'zero point four five' must come back as 0.45.
turns.prompt: The oxygen sensor is reading zero point four five volts. Is that normal?

turns.notes: Spoken thousands; 'two thousand five hundred' must come back as 2500.
turns.prompt: Engine speed is two thousand five hundred RPM at cruise. Does that sound right?

turns.notes: Chassis code.
turns.prompt: Code C one two three four, left front wheel speed sensor. What should I check?

turns.notes: Spoken hundreds; 'one hundred ninety-five' must come back as 195.
turns.prompt: Coolant temperature is one hundred ninety-five degrees. Is that too hot?

turns.notes: Same audio as T01, mixed with the impact-gun bed.
turns.prompt: The scanner shows P zero one seven one and P zero one seven four. What do those codes mean?

turns.notes: Same audio as T02, mixed with the compressor bed.
turns.prompt: I'm getting P zero three zero zero on the scanner. Is that a misfire?

turns.notes: Same audio as T03, mixed with the engine-idle bed.
turns.prompt: The VIN is one H G B H four one J X M N one zero nine one eight six. Can you confirm the vehicle?

turns.notes: Same audio as T05, mixed with the radio bed.
turns.prompt: The oxygen sensor is reading zero point four five volts. Is that normal?

turns.notes: Same audio as T06, mixed with the impact-gun bed.
turns.prompt: Engine speed is two thousand five hundred RPM at cruise. Does that sound right?

turns.notes: Same audio as T08, mixed with the compressor bed.
turns.prompt: Coolant temperature is one hundred ninety-five degrees. Is that too hot?

turns.notes: Interrupt mid-answer; scored on how fast the agent stops talking.
turns.prompt: My brakes squeal every time I stop, the pedal feels soft, and the steering wheel shakes at highway speed. What should I check first, and in what order?

turns.notes: Interrupt mid-answer; scored on how fast the agent stops talking.
turns.prompt: The check engine light is on, it idles rough, and it stalls at red lights. Where do I start?

turns.notes: Opens the guided-test exchange; the reply must start the procedure.
turns.prompt: Walk me through the idle relearn on this car, step by step.

turns.notes: Mid-procedure reading; the agent must hear the RPM and give the next step.
turns.prompt: Okay, I'm holding two thousand five hundred RPM now. What do I watch next?

turns.notes: Must call start_video_stream for the belt, and keep talking while the tool runs.
turns.prompt: Can you look at the serpentine belt? I think it's glazed.

turns.notes: Closes the guided-test exchange; the agent must hear the idle RPM.
turns.prompt: The relearn is done and the idle is steady at seven hundred fifty RPM. Is that right?

turns.notes: Still from a clip of an oil leak under the engine.
turns.prompt: What's leaking here?

turns.notes: Still from a clip of a coolant leak at a hose.
turns.prompt: What's leaking here? Is it coolant?

turns.notes: Still from a clip of a cracked serpentine belt.
turns.prompt: Does this belt need replacing?

turns.notes: Fifteen vs fifty is the classic mishear; the reply must say 15.
turns.prompt: The torque spec is fifteen foot-pounds for these bolts. Is that right?

turns.notes: Decimal reading over engine noise.
turns.prompt: Battery voltage is twelve point six volts with the engine off.

turns.notes: Short reading; the reply must repeat the pressure.
turns.prompt: Tire pressure is thirty-five PSI on the front left.

turns.notes: Part number over the radio bed.
turns.prompt: Order part number eight eight nine three two five one for me.

turns.notes: Short reading; the reply must repeat the pressure.
turns.prompt: Fuel pressure is fifty-eight PSI at idle.

turns.notes: Code turn cut off mid-answer; scored on the code and on the stop latency.
turns.prompt: P zero four two zero came up after the new exhaust went on. What does it mean, and do I need a new catalytic converter?

turns.notes: Final confirmation turn; the agent must hear the idle RPM.
turns.prompt: The idle relearn is done and it's steady at seven hundred fifty RPM now.
